rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when conceding defeat, an argument, or a contest.

example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 ngo5 jing6 syu1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when admitting that something is true or acknowledging a fact.

example.english: I concede that this news is true.
example.traditional: 我承認呢個消息係真嘅。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sing4 jing6 ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 hai6 zan1 ge3

rows.note: Use this in football or other ball sports when your team allows the opposition to score.

example.english: To concede a goal right after kickoff was a real blow.
example.traditional: 下半場一開波就失波，真係好傷。
example.jyutping: haa6 bun3 coeng4 jat1 hoi1 bo1 zau6 sat1 bo1 zan1 hai6 hou2 soeng1
